purpose: Determine whether the frozen train/dev split has enough repeated-QA crossed-metric support to identify a conditional-fidelity direction before any full audit or new method work.

identity.metric_pair_counting: Each unordered metric pair is counted at most once per QA node, even if a response-metric edge has duplicate rows.

sequential_rule: If pair-support requirements fail, return NO_GO_INSUFFICIENT_CROSSED_METRIC_SUPPORT and do not estimate human contrast reliability or model conditional fidelity on post-hoc pooled sparse pairs.
interpretation: A NO-GO is a limitation of the current dev design for this scientific question, not evidence that rubric conditional insensitivity is absent.
